name: Parochial and Plain Sermons, Volume 3
desc: Volume 3 of Newman's Parochial and Plain Sermons: 25 of the sermons he preached at St. Mary's, Oxford and Littlemore as an Anglican vicar. Newman reissued the series unchanged in 1868, as a Catholic, through his friend William John Copeland; this is the Longmans text. The sermons are on holiness, faith, the Christian year, the saints and the life of obedience.
desc_pt: Volume 3 dos Parochial and Plain Sermons de Newman: 25 dos sermões que ele pregou em Santa Maria, Oxford, e em Littlemore, como vigário anglicano. Newman reeditou a série sem alterações em 1868, já católico, por meio do amigo William John Copeland; este é o texto da Longmans. Os sermões tratam da santidade, da fé, do ano cristão, dos santos e da vida de obediência.
editor: John Henry Newman, ed. William John Copeland (Rivingtons, 1868; Newman Reader)
edition: Parochial and Plain Sermons, vol. 3 (London: Rivingtons, 1868 edition of the series first published 1834-1843), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
note: Anglican-period sermons, reissued by Newman in 1868.
